title: BetterScale · DeepSeek V4 Flash execution study

source.disclosure: Curated public measurement summary. Raw traces and implementation are not bundled; the referenced commit and documents are available in the public GitHub repository.

environment.timing: Unprofiled, normal HCCL, no state oracle; median across eight per-rank cycle medians. Source pins do not assert byte-identical rebuilds of historical installed packages.

studies.topology: TP1 / DP8 / EP8, K5, 16 global requests, 2 requests / 12 queries per rank, DSACP off
studies.budget: 1026 local tokens, max length 16384, 8 GiB KV/rank
studies.selection: First 10 consecutive common occupied cycle ordinals per repeat; target FULL, native eager draft. Both arms retain experimental allocations. Not a stock whole-service comparison.

short_mixed.control: Prior optimized FULL-target control, not stock vLLM
short_mixed.geometry: TP8 K5; budget 4128; capture 24/4128; max length 8256; 3 GiB KV/rank; 64 output tokens/request
short_mixed.aggregation: Warm matching scheduled-row observations; medians across ranks; a single paired shape observation, not a universal gain

quality.dataset: 32 retained original-input OpenCompass LongBench English retrieval questions
quality.tp_geometry: Original 9921–14997-token inputs; 32-token output cap, EOS honored; TP8/K5, four seats, budget 4128, max length 15104, 12 GiB KV/rank
quality.scope: Subset only, not the complete OpenCompass suite or general quality certification

limits: Matched-cycle gains are not stable end-to-end throughput, TTFT or maximum-concurrency gains.
TP increments are separate studies: do not add percentage reductions or present their cumulative progression as a direct stock-to-final A/B.
Short mixed gains do not imply a general large-prefill speedup.
DP unprofiled intervals do not imply every profiled wave is bubble-free; a separate aligned profile retains an approximately 10 ms gap.
No KV capacity, mapped C4, PCP or all-mode N+2 scheduler claim is included.

service_http.method: Total output tokens divided by total duration of nine synthetic HTTP cohorts (three workloads, three repeats), excluding startup, separately logged prelude and quality. No slow repeat removed.
service_http.scope: Same hw3, 8x910B2 HCCS, DSV4 W8A8 K5. DP and TP have different concurrency and separate native comparators. Reused qualified measurements, not a new 0.3.1 wheel benchmark.

rows.provenance: Qualified startup program carried into 0.3.1; 0.3.0 measured -6.11% and is retained in source report.
0.3.0 measured TP path is unchanged in 0.3.1; native comparator includes only LCM startup compatibility.

limits: One process per arm, sequential runs; not randomized independent replications.
TP decode chunk-gap P99 worsened; no universal latency win.
These are synthetic HTTP workloads, not full agent traces, maximum concurrency or SLO capacity.

startup_smoke.command_substitution: Model filesystem path only; native CANN/HCCL environment provided externally.
startup_smoke.scope: Actual public-wheel installation and DP8 startup/one short HTTP completion. Not a throughput or quality rerun; TP8 launch has CPU contract and retained prior path evidence, not a new TP8 service smoke.
startup_smoke.teardown_note: Native peer-disconnect messages followed supervised termination after the successful response; all eight cards were reclaimed.

capacity.boundary: No new throughput comparison; running includes partial prefill; no preemption recovery claim; APC disabled

prefix_reuse.scope: native APC compatibility, retained retrieval subset; engine-local DP; no new throughput or preemption claim
